prompt: PDB entry 1CTQ: the HRAS (GTPase HRas, UniProt P01112) variant G12S is classified as pathogenic in ClinVar. Show the whole structure as a white cartoon, with the residue it replaces as cyan ball-and-stick.

checks: target (1 residue(s), 4 atoms, residue name(s) GLY = the wild type) is the same atom set by three routes on the frozen atom table: label numbering from the frozen variant file, author numbering as written in the MVS reference, and the frozen SIFTS lookup of the UniProt position
the reference grades as exactly right against the task (success, F1 = 1, target score 1), and so does every accepted alternative
the twin on the other track selects the same target atoms
graded what the number in the variant's name selects when taken at face value as the author residue number (right) and as the label residue number (right); recorded under clinical.difficulty

clinical.api_note: pdbe-molstar resolves uniprot_accession + uniprot_residue_number itself (SIFTS), so this API task tests knowing that selector and supplying the accession; its MVS twin tests doing the UniProt-to-structure mapping.
